answer: Resource-Proof Registration: each identity must submit a fresh physical assay sample whose chain-of-custody is signed by an independent lab, binding the account to a material lot traceable to a specific orchard. Registration only completes when a hashed pearl-grade certificate matches that lot, so the operator cannot forge provenance without acquiring genuine harvest stock. Duplicating one identity costs a full lot purchase plus lab fees, scaling linearly and making mass sybils economically self-defeating.
